summary: SOME (PACIFIC/WALDORF EDITION) MOTOR HOMES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO.. 120 "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."   UNDER CERTAIN LOADING CONDITIONS, THE FRONT GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING (GAWR) COULD BE EXCEEDED.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: ENGINE TURBOCHARGER/SERIES 40/DETROIT DIESEL (21 affected)

ALSO, DUE TO THE INADEQUATE JOINT STRENGTH, THESE BUSES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE SEAT TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 210, SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: HEADLIGHT SWITCH OVERLOADING (451 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH IN THE FRONT ELECTRICAL BOX/FIREWALL CAN OVERLOAD.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: HYDRAULIC FAN MOTOR FLANGE FITTING ASSEMBLY (665 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES, HYDRAULIC FLUID CAN LEAK AT THE FLANGE FITTING DUE TO IMPROPER INSTALLATION PROCEDURES.  INCORRECT INSTALLATION PROCEDURES MAY CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE O-RING OF THE FLANGE ASSEMBLY, COMPROMISING THE SEALING CAPABILITY OF THE O-RING.

title: International Motors, LLC: PARK BRAKE ANCHOR BOLT/BOSCH (13,654 affected)

THIS RECALL WILL BE LAUNCHED IN THE "SALT BELT" STATES OF CONNECTICUT, DELAWARE, ILLINOIS, INDIANA, IOWA, MARYLAND, MASSACHUSETTS, MAINE, MICHIGAN, MINNESOTA, MISSOURI, NEW HAMPSHIRE, NEW JERSEY, NEW YORK, OHIO, PENNSYLVANIA, RHODE ISLAND, VERMONT, WEST VIRGINIA, WISCONSIN AND THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA ONLY.

ERRATIC VOLTAGE SUPPLY TO THE FUEL LIFT PUMP CAUSES PREMATURE ELECTRIC BRUSH WEAR INTERNAL TO THE FUEL LIFT PUMP. title: CPSC, Stork Craft Manufacturing Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Boxes
summary: The toy box's lid support can fail, allowing the lid to collapse suddenly. This poses a strangulation hazard to young children, and possible impact injuries to a child's head, neck, fingers or hands. Units: About 3,000.

summary: The amount of glue used to bond and hold the joints together on these stools could be insufficient. These stools could break and collapse during use, causing consumers to fall. Units: About 2,200.

summary: The band on the watch contains liquid petroleum distillates. If punctured, the watch band could leak. Petroleum distillates could be harmful if ingested and cause irritation to the skin or eyes on contact. Units: About 50,400.

title: CPSC, Torelli Imports Announce Recall of Bicycle Tires
summary: The tire can separate from the wheel, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 1,100.

title: CPSC, JS Products and Mac Tools Announce Recall of Cordless Drill/Drivers
summary: The battery packs on these drill/drivers can overheat, expand and possibly rupture, creating an explosion or thermal burn hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, The Gymboree Corp. Announce Recall of Baby Sandals
summary: A plastic flower attached to the sandals can pull or snap off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,600.

title: CPSC, Ritchey Design Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
summary: The hub in the bicycle's rear wheel can fail to engage properly, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider can lose balance, fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, The Holmes Group Announce Recall of Tower Heater Fans
summary: The power cord on the units can fray or sever, causing the fan to stop working and overheat. This could pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 180,000.

title: CPSC, Kelty Announce Recall of Speedster Jogging Strollers
summary: The stroller handle can disconnect from the stroller frame during use. Units: 349.

title: CPSC, American Classic Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
summary: The hub in the bicycle's rear wheel can fail to engage properly, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 2,850.

title: CPSC, Tile Perfect Inc. Announce Recall of Stand'n Seal Grout Sealer Due to Respiratory Problems
summary: The product's odor is not chemically pungent enough to force consumers to minimize their exposure to the fumes. Consumers overexposed to these fumes can experience respiratory-related illness. Units: About 300,000 cans.

title: CPSC, Hidden Hills Productions, Inc. Announce Recall of Floor Mat Map Games
summary: The orange paint on the floor mat maps contains excess levels of lead. Lead poisoning is a serious hazard to children and is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 140.

summary: A hose connecting the natural gas source to the grill's main manifold may not have been supplied with these grills. Without this hose, the gas would be emitted into the air, creating a potential fire hazard. Consumers should not use the grill until the main burner hose is provided. Units: 644.

title: CPSC, Lamplight Farms Inc. Announce Recall of Tiki Bamboo Torches and Replacement Fuel Canisters
summary: The surface coating of some flame guards on these bamboo torches and replacement canisters can absorb the fuel and ignite. summary: The stitching that attaches the webbing to the carrier/sling can break, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 165.
